detail.readme:
oRPC - Typesafe APIs Made Simple 🪄

**oRPC** is a TypeScript framework for building end-to-end typesafe APIs. Write your API once as plain TypeScript functions, and oRPC gives you a fully typed client, a REST API with an OpenAPI document, and MCP tools for AI agents, with no code generation. It runs on Node.js, Bun, Deno, Cloudflare Workers, and more. Define procedures on the server and serve them with an [RPC handler](https://orpc.dev/docs/rpc/handler): ```ts import { os } from '@orpc/server' import * as z from 'zod' export const router = { planet: { find: os .input(z.object({ id: z.number() })) .handler(({ input }) => ({ id: input.id, name: 'Earth' })), }, } ``` Then call them from a client that knows every input and output, without generating anything: ```ts import { createORPCClient } from '@orpc/client' import { RPCLink } from '@orpc/client/fetch' import type { RouterClient } from '@orpc/server' import type { router } from './router' const link = new RPCLink({ origin: 'http://localhost:3000', url: '/rpc' }) const client: RouterClient = createORPCClient(link) const planet = await client.planet.find({ id: 1 }) // { id: number, name: string } ``` ## Documentation Read the full documentation at [orpc.dev](https://orpc.dev), starting with the [Getting Started guide](https://orpc.dev/docs/getting-started). ## Packages
